gloss: quitting salaried work to go independent; leaving company employment

definitions.gloss: quitting salaried work to go independent; leaving company employment
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving a stable salaried job at a company to start one's own business or become self-employed. A blend of 脱 (escape from) and サラ (short for サラリーマン).

examples.japanese: {脱サラ|だつさら}して、カフェを{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: I quit my salaried job and opened a café.

examples.japanese: {脱サラ|だつさら}を{夢見|ゆめみ}ているサラリーマンは{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many salaried workers dream of quitting to start their own business.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{大手企業|おおてきぎょう}を{辞|や}めて{脱サラ|だつさら}し、{農業|のうぎょう}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: He quit a major company, left salaried work behind, and started farming.

notes:
A compound abbreviation combining 脱 (escape, shed) and サラ (short for サラリーマン, salaryman). Also used as a suru-verb: 脱サラする (to quit salaried employment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱サラ|だつさら}する: to quit salaried employment
- {脱サラ|だつさら}して起業する: to quit and start a business
- {脱サラ|だつさら}{組|くみ}: people who have quit salaried work
- {脱サラ|だつさら}{農家|のうか}: former salaryman turned farmer
